clips.title: The story
paras: Grelin Whitebeard's report now travels from Coldridge Valley to Senir in Kharanos. Its findings carry news of the valley's threats beyond the sheltered training grounds of Anvilmar.

Grelin Whitebeard has recovered his stolen journal from the Frostmane trolls and prepared a report on the valley's threats for his brother Senir. Mountaineer Thalos guards the gate out of Coldridge Valley and gives the dispatch to travelers passing through. The route leads through a mountain tunnel recently overrun by violent troggs that ambush anyone crossing. Beyond it, the main road runs through central Dun Morogh to Kharanos.

Senir Whitebeard is warming himself over drinks at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos when Grelin's report arrives. He chuckles at his brother's forceful words. Grelin invokes King Magni Bronzebeard to press for urgent action, and Senir says the tactic is bound to agitate the stubborn Ironforge Senate. Senir admits the bitter cold has kept him from filing his own observations. Grelin's dispatch spurs him back to his duties, watching hostile forces across the snowfields.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.
Directions? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.
Make your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What's this? Ah, my brother's report. Hmm...

I told him to be sparing with the use of the King's name, but he didn't listen. No harm, I suppose, though it's sure to ruffle some feathers in the Senate. Not that those weren't some feathers that needed ruffling! Hah!
Nonetheless, I guess that means that I should send my report on to Ironforge as well, but I must admit I'm a bit behind. Bloody cold.
I should have some work for you later, if you're interested.
